entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to reallocate a GUTI and optionally provide a new TAI list, DCN-ID, or UE radio capability information.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Specifies the security header format for the message.

entities.name: GUTI reallocation command message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message as GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: EPS mobile identity containing the reallocated GUTI.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Optional tracking area identity list provided during GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: DCN-ID
entities.description: Optional dedicated core network identifier provided during GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Optional UE radio capability identifier provided during GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: Optional indication to delete stored UE radio capability ID.

entities.name: Optional IEs presence
entities.description: Condition where TAI list, DCN-ID, UE radio capability ID, or UE radio capability ID deletion indication may be optionally included in the message.

relations.description: GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains the Protocol discriminator IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains the Security header type IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains the Message type IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains the GUTI IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may optionally contain the TAI list IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may optionally contain the DCN-ID IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may optionally contain the UE radio capability ID IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may optionally contain the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE.
Optional presence of TAI list IE is guarded by the condition for optional IEs.
Optional presence of DCN-ID IE is guarded by the condition for optional IEs.
Optional presence of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition for optional IEs.
Optional presence of UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE is guarded by the condition for optional IEs.
